methods.label: Rolling top-22 PVS (≥2 of last 4 rounds)

core22Impact.interpretation: Core-22 analysis counts misses only from expected selected players, not the full extended squad. Outside midfield absences correlate most strongly with losses; key defender star absences show a clearer win-rate drop than key forwards. Total missed PVS still matters more than role alone.

ladderPvsRanks.interpretation: Ladder rank from home-and-away wins and percentage. PVS-lost rank sorts clubs by season games-missed PVS (rank 1 = fewest lost). Injury weights use injury_weight_pvs for players with fewer than 14 games played. Rank delta = ladder rank − PVS-lost rank: negative means the club finished higher on the ladder than its injury toll would suggest; positive means they finished lower.
